feeding_claim.verbatim: We offer grass fed, grass finished beef because we believe it is better for the earth and ourselves.

farmers_markets: Old Town Scottsdale Farmers Market, Scottsdale (Saturdays, October to June)
Gilbert Farmers Market at CGCC, Chandler (Saturdays)

pickup_locations: Gallery of Food Bodega, 2522 E. Fort Lowell Road, Tucson (pre-order pickup Fridays and Saturdays)

address: 4965 N S Camino Rio Rd, Winkelman, AZ 85192
notes: Lamb described as grass-fed and grass-raised from hair sheep born on the farm's pastures; pork is Mangalitsa raised in a pasture-based setting; laying hens on pasture with organic corn- and soy-free grain. Online orders through Barn2Door with pickup at a chosen market. Quarter, half and whole beef shares year-round. FAQ says no delivery and no shipping yet (hopes to ship in 2026). Farm visits and pickup by appointment only. No phone published; contact form only. Also sells pickles from its garden.
